description: This file provides a custom implementation of an XML tree builder and serializer using the lxml.etree library, supporting specific tree structures and handling edge cases with warnings.

classes.name: DocumentType
classes.description: Represents a Document Type Declaration with name, publicId, and systemId.

classes.name: Document
classes.description: Represents an XML document with methods to manage its element tree and child nodes.

classes.name: TreeBuilder
classes.description: Custom tree builder class extending _base.TreeBuilder, supporting document creation, doctype insertion, and serialization.

methods.name: appendChild
methods.description: Adds a child element to the document’s root element.

methods.name: _getChildNodes
methods.description: Returns the list of child nodes.

methods.name: testSerializer
methods.description: Serializes an element to a string for testing purposes.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Returns the current document or its root element.

methods.name: getFragment
methods.description: Returns a fragment of the document as a list of elements.

methods.name: insertDoctype
methods.description: Inserts a doctype declaration into the document, with warnings for unsupported cases.

methods.name: insertCommentInitial
methods.description: Stores initial comments before document creation.

methods.name: insertCommentMain
methods.description: Inserts comments into the document, with warnings for unsupported scenarios.

methods.name: insertRoot
methods.description: Creates the document root element, handling doctype and comments, and sets up internal structures.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the tree builder state, including comment insertion mode and doctype.
